decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 down at C564-14 until about 13:20 (likely). The stope has 138 t at 12.1 gpt, about 54 oz. LH-09 comes from the DS-C564-02 heading, 0.34 h away. The heading is the cheapest source, at 1.5 oz/h. LH-09 loads at 29.1 t/h, so about 105 t (~41 oz) by 13:20 against about 6 oz of development lost. Central trucks (91 t/h) and the stockpile have room. LH-08 is farther away (0.71 h) and its heading is Norte. Taking a producing stope's loader would cost more. Radio and CMMS agree, so no confirmation is needed.

Keep LH-09 on C564-14 (12.1 g/t, 121 t, LH-01 down until ≥12:20). LH-02 down at C512-06 until ~16:00 (251 t at 9.2 g/t, ~74 oz). Lend LH-08 from the cheap heading DS-N522-01 (1.0 oz/h) to C512-06 (0.75 h travel). It loads about 30 t/h for ~6.25 h, so ~187 t, or ~55 oz, against ~7 oz of development lost. Central trucks (91 t/h) have room while LH-09 finishes its stope. LH-10 is in PM until 12:00 and is not used.
